summary_en: This study tests RBS2418 added to the STRIDE regimen (tremelimumab plus durvalumab) in adults with advanced, unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma. RBS2418 is taken by mouth at 200 mg or 800 mg twice daily, and tremelimumab 300 mg IV is given once on cycle 1 day 1, while durvalumab 1500 mg IV is given every 4 weeks; total treatment duration is not stated. The main outcome is not stated in the record, and the study is Phase 2 (described as Phase 2a).
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa RBS2418 añadido al régimen STRIDE (tremelimumab más durvalumab) en adultos con carcinoma hepatocelular avanzado e irresecable. RBS2418 se toma por vía oral a dosis de 200 mg o 800 mg dos veces al día, tremelimumab 300 mg por vía intravenosa se administra solo en el día 1 del ciclo 1 y durvalumab 1500 mg por vía intravenosa cada 4 semanas; la duración total del tratamiento no está indicada. El resultado principal no está indicado en el registro, y el estudio es de Fase 2 (descrito como Fase 2a).
who_for: Adults aged 18 or older at the time of consent
Eligible to receive the STRIDE regimen as first-line therapy
Willing to provide a pre-treatment tissue sample (archival or fresh)
not_for: BCLC stage D disease at screening or before the first dose
Child-Pugh class equal to or higher than B8 at screening or within 7 days before the first dose
Eligible for curative treatments such as surgical resection, liver transplantation, or local ablation
Rapid progression on prior therapy with rapid clinical deterioration
